briefs.text: Funeral boat capsizes: at least 4 dead
Court lets TPS end for ~600,000 Venezuelans
Man guilty of starting Palisades fire
Zelenskyy calls Putin 'a killer' at APEC
Plan advances for West Bank city of 200,000
Migrant boat sinks: dozens missing off coast
Floods leave six dead across Kenya
Somalia expels UAE ambassador in row
Europe seeks peace role, UN force swap
Quake felt here, and in N. Australia

date_check.body: First reported Thu 19 / Fri 20 Nov, so NOT shown as Saturday's news: Russian missiles down in SE Poland (Fri 20) · Wall Street's fall into correction (Fri 20) · the UK-EU reset deals (Fri 20) · the Kyiv bridges barrage (Fri 20) · the Shenzhen summit, Anthropic's IPO and the ICJ Myanmar verdict (Thu 19)
date_check.title: DATE CHECK

edition.footer_claim: Every story above was first reported on Saturday 21 November 2026 (UTC); earlier news is named in the DATE CHECK strip, not shown as Saturday's. Claims are attributed, not stated as fact.
edition.footer_sources: Sources: Reuters, AP, UN News, BMKG, USGS, AFP, BBC, ESA, CAAP, Ukrinform.  Original drawings.
edition.strapline: COP31 runs into overtime  ·  Riyadh intercepts three missiles  ·  M6.7 quake shakes Peru
